work.title: The Key
work.text: At midnight, Mira found the city's last key in her coat. She had promised to return it. Instead, she held it against the locked library door and listened to the people waiting inside. By dawn the key was warm, but she had not turned it.

cases.manual_oracle: Analyze tensions, ambiguity and limited character evidence across 14 areas; don't invent historical setting, intentions, events, or literary sources absent from the passage. Overarching synthesis addresses success and coherence with calibrated scope.

work.title: Weather
work.text:
Silver streets swallow the storm.
A small bell shakes beneath the bridge.
Someone stays until the sound is gone.

cases.manual_oracle: Stylistic lens identifies grounded sound pattern ('Silver streets swallow'); distinguishes phonetic observation from speculative author intention. Other lenses should honestly state where a three-line text cannot sustain deep conclusions.
